title: Let admins update a product's name or price
description: Adds PATCH /api/products/:id. Admins send `name`, `priceCents` or both; fields left out keep their value. A price of 0 is allowed, for free samples. Includes tests and a README entry.

comments.issue: `||` treats a price of 0 as missing, so setting a product's price to 0 (free samples, which the PR allows) silently keeps the old price; use `??` or check for undefined.
